capabilities: Sync vault files with OneDrive, SharePoint and Teams libraries
Share vaults with read/write or read-only access
Browse and restore note version history
Sync shared .obsidian settings while excluding tokens
extras: Enterprise use needs a one-time Entra ID public-client app registration by an administrator; organizations can add their email domain to a built-in configuration lookup by pull request. Diagnostic logs redact tokens and signatures.
intentEvidence: Official Obsidian Sync requires a separate subscription and stores vault data outside your organization's Microsoft 365 tenant.
motivation: The author wanted the OneNote-on-SharePoint workflow — Entra ID access control, per-project sharing and built-in version history — available for Obsidian vaults.
problem: Teams using Microsoft 365 had no way to collaborate on Obsidian vaults without external servers, duplicate conflict files or a separate sync subscription.

relations.evidence: Official Obsidian Sync requires a separate subscription and stores vault data outside your organization's Microsoft 365 tenant.
Custom sync tools (CouchDB / LiveSync, Git, S3/WebDAV) require provisioning external servers
Syncing a vault folder with the OneDrive desktop client frequently creates Note (Work PC's conflicted copy).md duplicates

requires.name: Microsoft account or Microsoft Entra ID work account
Microsoft 365 with SharePoint Online and Teams (enterprise sync)

summary: Syncs Obsidian vaults through Microsoft OneDrive, SharePoint and Teams, with per-vault sharing, 3-way merge and version restore.
